tytul: Garlic in balsamic vinegar, canned: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for garlic canned in balsamic vinegar. [T:-]

ostrzezenia.tekst: UC ANR says canning garlic is not recommended: garlic is a low-acid vegetable that needs a pressure canner, and adequate processing times have not been determined. [T:ACI-436]
Acidifying whole garlic cloves in vinegar is a lengthy and highly variable process, so there are no guidelines for acidifying whole garlic cloves at home. [T:ACI-437]

akapity: The FDA list gives garlic a pH of about 5.80. [T:ACI-106]
Oregon State University Extension also says that pressure canning processing times have not been developed for plain garlic. [T:ACI-440]
White distilled vinegar and cider vinegar of 5% acidity are recommended for pickles. [T:ACI-018]
JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for canning garlic in balsamic vinegar. [T:-]
UC ANR describes covering peeled garlic cloves with undiluted vinegar and keeping them in the refrigerator, not canning them. [T:ACI-512,ACI-436]
JarAtlas has a separate card for garlic in vinegar kept in the refrigerator. [T:-]
